source_evidence: Exact player 'Explain ourselves and our intentions and our authority' explicitly delegates this explanation only. V explains established claimed Viscount of Vaishnavi identity, actually held Crown conditional recovery instrument (not current ownership), intention to restore the site, protect free residents/travelers, defend weak and follow Ossent law, and offers voluntary renewed guardianship on same terms as first warder. First warder meaningfully Helps by endorsing new charge and reporting its own provisional acceptance. Predeclared Persuasion +7 advantage DC18, genuine visible Python secrets receipt batch c02725f538bc73b87e2bafbf10efb373 faces16,1 take16+7=23 success. Second warder independently accepts provisional service on these terms, not automatic magical loyalty, recognition of verified lineage, title, or proof of safe future conduct. Second opens its own lower chamber door, remains armed but nonaggressive; its two skeletons lower weapons on its order. Water visibly about ankle-to-knee deep (~2ft) in lower chamber from stair sightline, no lever operated, no party descent or archive entry. Second warder offers inspection of guarded records and asks for clear direction about continued watch, no formal property transfer or confiscation. Names not yet established. First warder and second both provisionally accept duty to protect living and not detain peaceful people; each commands its existing two skeletons. No further encounter, attack, initiative, oath magic, copying, fees, wages, external resident consent, Crown legal certification, site clearance or new resource spent. V chooses next response. Day331~16:40.
